Preparing the Data


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mpsz = read_rds("data/rds/mpsz_sf.rds")
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
BusStop = st_read(dsn = "data/Geospatial/",
                  layer = "BusStop") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```


```{.r .cell-code}
tm_shape(mpsz) +
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(BusStop) +
  tm_dots()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
BusStop_in_SG <- st_join(
  BusStop, mpsz,
  join = st_within,
  left = FALSE)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tm_shape(mpsz) +
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(BusStop_in_SG) +
  tm_dots()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex06_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon <- st_make_grid(mpsz,
                        cellsize = 700,
                        what = "polygon",
                        square = FALSE) %>%
  st_sf()
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon$n_collisions = 
  lengths(st_intersects(
    hexagon, BusStop_in_SG))

hexagon <- filter(hexagon, n_collisions > 0)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hexagon <- hexagon %>%
  select(, -n_collisions)

hexagon$HEX_ID <- sprintf(
  "H%04d", seq_len(nrow(hexagon))) %>%
  as.factor()
    
kable(head(hexagon))
```

```{.r .cell-code}
trips <- odbus %>%
  select(c(ORIGIN_PT_CODE, DAY_TYPE, TIME_PER_HOUR, TOTAL_TRIPS)) %>%
  rename(BUS_STOP_N = ORIGIN_PT_CODE) %>%
  rename(HOUR_OF_DAY = TIME_PER_HOUR) %>%
  rename(TRIPS = TOTAL_TRIPS)
trips$BUS_STOP_N <- as.factor(trips$BUS_STOP_N)
kable(head(trips))
```
